data: imagenette2-160 (fast.ai), shorter side 160 px, CLIP processor resizes to 224

probe.features: CLS vector after each block (index 0 = embeddings), standardised

neuron_rule: layers 3, 7, 11; neuron = numpy default_rng(0).integers(3072), in that order; score = max over the 49 patch tokens of the MLP hidden value (after quick-GELU)
